session_summary: Blue title bar: 'Bear Trend, Mid-day Reversal'. Surprise bear breakout at the open (09:00) with 2nd leg down likely, a tight early trading range 6277-6295, then a large bear breakout with consecutive sell climaxes (10:15-11:50, low 6240) and possible exhaustion. Strong reversal up after the sell climax marked a possible low of day, bulls tested the top of the bear breakout bar at 12:15 (minor reversal at 13:15 on the magenta dotted 6288 support), then a tight bull channel carried price to 6309 (14:40) before a late pullback closed at 6299. Footer 7/17.
